name: approval-gitea-reviews-0
cmd: bun install --frozen-lockfile >/dev/null 2>&1; GDP_INFER_TRACE=2 timeout -s KILL 100 bun research/realworld/score.ts --one 'approval/gitea/reviews' 0 --ms 60000 2>/tmp/e.log | tail -1 | cut -c1-200; echo engine_events $(grep -cE 'join (template|small instance|enumerated)' /tmp/e.log); echo joins $(grep -c 'join end' /tmp/e.log); grep -E 'join (template|small instance|enumerated|end)' /tmp/e.log | head -6 | cut -c1-200
